info.title: Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting
info.description:
Provides functionality for managing the freight orders for subcontracting process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the consumer of the API.
SAP Business Network for Logistics calls the defined endpoints within other systems.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to manage the freight orders for subcontracting process.

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

post.summary: Creates a freight order for subcontracting in another system
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party creates a freight order for subcontracting.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight order for subcontracting to be created or updated.

200.description: Freight order for subcontracting updated successfully.

201.description: Freight order for subcontracting created successfully.

application/json.message: Freight order [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship betweeen the ordering party (ID: 10000042) and the carrier (ID: 10000043) has not yet been established.

put.summary: Updates a freight order for subcontracting in another system.
put.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party updates a freight order for subcontracting.
The implementation must be able to handle multiple endpoint calls.
This may happen if SAP Business Network for Logistics receives an updated freight order for subcontracting from the ordering party.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: orderingPartyLbnId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

parameters.name: originatorId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party's originating system.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight order for subcontracting to be created or updated.

200.description: Freight order for subcontracting updated successfully.

201.description: Freight order for subcontracting created successfully.

application/json.message: Freight order [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship of Ordering Party (shipper) LBN Id: 10000042 and Carrier Party LBN Id: 10000043 has not yet been established

post.summary: Cancels a freight order for subcontracting in another system.
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party cancels a freight order for subcontracting.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: orderingPartyLbnId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

parameters.name: originatorId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party's originating system.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight order for subcontracting to be canceled.

200.description: Freight order for subcontracting canceled successfully.

application/json.message: Freight order [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship of Ordering Party (shipper) LBN Id: 10000042 and Carrier Party LBN Id: 10000043 has not yet been established

post.summary: Awards a freight order for subcontracting in another system.
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party awards a freight order for subcontracting to a carrier.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: orderingPartyLbnId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

parameters.name: originatorId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party's originating system.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight order for subcontracting to be awarded.

200.description: Freight order for subcontracting awarded successfully.

application/json.message: Freight order [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship of Ordering Party (shipper) LBN Id: 10000042 and Carrier Party LBN Id: 10000043 has not yet been established

mimeCode.description:
Content type code of the attachment.
* image/jpeg - Mime code for image files with .jpeg extension
* image/jpg - Mime code for image files with .jpg extension
* image/png - Mime code for image files with .png extension
* image/gif - Mime code for image files with .gif extension
* image/tiff - Mime code for image files with .tiff extension
* image/tiff-fx - Mime code for image files with .tiff-fx extension
* application/pdf - Mime code for files with .pdf extension
* application/msword - Mime code for files with .doc extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document - Mime code for files with .docx extension
* application/vnd.ms-excel - Mime code for files with .xls extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet - Mime code for files with .xlsx extension
